content_sections.heading: About NDDTC AIIMS Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: The National Drug Dependence Treatment Centre (NDDTC) is a centre of AIIMS, New Delhi; the Hindi version of the notice names it as NDDTC, Department of Psychiatry, AIIMS, New Delhi. This Project Technical Support-III post is a contractual post in an ICMR-funded research project at NDDTC, Ghaziabad, titled "Development and Validation of an Instrument to Assess Treatment Barriers Among Adolescents with Substance Use in the Community."

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Masters in Social Work (MSW) with specialization in: Medical & Psychiatric Social Work or Community Development / Community Organization OR Bachelors in Social Work (BSW) + 3 years of relevant experience The 3 years of experience apply only to candidates applying with a BSW. Candidates with interest and experience in community-based mental health, child and adolescent programs, or addiction services will be given preference. The upper age limit for the Project Technical Support-III post is 35 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility wording for this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The current emolument of the Project Technical Support-III post is Rs. 28,000 plus 30% HRA. The notice states that the emoluments may change as per the ICMR norms. The post is contractual and full-time. The Principal Investigator reserves the right to terminate the contract with one month's notice. The length of the contract is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NDDTC AIIMS Project Technical Support-III
content_sections.text: Applications go by email only to [email protected] , and the last date of application is 27 November 2026. Prepare a CV of not more than 3 pages. Scan copies of your supporting documents. Write the name of the post (Project Technical Support-III) clearly in the email subject line. Email the CV and scanned documents to [email protected] on or before 27 November 2026. CV (not more than 3 pages) Scanned copies of supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview for the post and states that no TA/DA will be reimbursed for appearing for the interview. The interview date, venue and mode are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Place of reporting and work will be East Delhi and Ghaziabad (U.P.). This is a full-time post, and no other part-time or full-time employment will be allowed. No TA/DA will be reimbursed for appearing for the interview.
